author: Kranti Mulik
publication: Selected paper, 2015 AAEA/WAEA Annual Meeting; not represented here as a peer-reviewed journal article
definition: Published estimated net returns to management, including land and labor costs. Not farm cash accounts or current prices.
units: Yield bu/ac except alfalfa ton/ac; price USD/bu except alfalfa USD/ton; net returns USD/ac
cautions: Table means do not provide year-level yield-price covariance or line-item costs.
Do not derive actual cost as mean yield times mean price minus mean net return.
Oat grain yield excludes straw, while the net-return scope must retain the author's enterprise definition.
Table 2's printed 4-year mean N rate repeats 7.66 even though 22.98/4=5.745; it is not admitted as a verified rotation N criterion.
Technology packages differ in herbicide and cultivar practice; results are conditional on the published packages, not isolated GE effects.
